cohort: 690 term and late preterm small for gestational age neonates in a well-baby newborn nursery of a tertiary medical center in Southern Taiwan, born between January 1, 2012 and December 31, 2020
finding: 19.42% of term and late preterm SGA neonates developed hypoglycemia during their well-baby nursery stay, with 97% of early hypoglycemic episodes occurring during the first 2 hours of life.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a significant risk factor for early hypoglycemia in term and late preterm SGA neonates.
